name: apply_healing
description: Applies healing to a character or NPC, up to their maximum HP. Healing does not affect temporary HP.

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a player character or an NPC.

entity.description: The slug or UUID of the character or NPC to heal.

amount.description: The amount of HP to restore.

temporary.description: If true, grants temporary HP instead of restoring current HP. Temporary HP does not stack — only the higher value is kept.
